-- Satellite chỉ tiêu quý nhập tay của môi giới, grain: (broker_hk, ingested_ts). Mẫu T-SAT.
-- TH-NHAPTAY: file v2 thay v1 kể từ ingested_ts (commit_ts) của nó; dòng chưa duyệt đã bị loại ở staging.
with w as (
    select broker_hk,
           ingested_ts, event_ts, sat_broker_kpi_hd as hash_diff, record_source,
           broker_id, target_new_clients, target_calls, target_aum_bil, approver, approved_date
    from "cap_mg_phucnd_evidence"."staging"."stg_manual__kpi"
    where (ingested_ts > '-infinity'::timestamptz and ingested_ts <= '2026-05-15T16:30:00.000000+00:00'::timestamptz)
      and broker_hk is not null
),

-- bỏ dòng trùng nguyên nội dung cùng thời điểm; trùng khóa mà khác nội dung đã bị GT-STG-KEYTS chặn
v as (
    select distinct on (broker_hk, ingested_ts, hash_diff) *
    from w
    order by broker_hk, ingested_ts, hash_diff, event_ts
),

seq as (
    select v.*,
           lag(v.hash_diff) over (partition by broker_hk order by v.ingested_ts) as prev_hd,
           row_number() over (partition by broker_hk order by v.ingested_ts) as rn
    from v
)

select seq.broker_hk,

from seq
where seq.hash_diff is distinct from seq.prev_hd
